description: This file defines the DefaultEventHubBlockPoolMonitor class, which is a specialized monitor for object pools used by the EventHubStreamProvider in Orleans. It inherits from DefaultBlockPoolMonitor and initializes monitoring dimensions based on EventHub-specific parameters.

classes.name: DefaultEventHubBlockPoolMonitor
classes.description: A monitor class for tracking object pool metrics specific to EventHubStreamProvider, inheriting from DefaultBlockPoolMonitor.

methods.name: DefaultEventHubBlockPoolMonitor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the monitor with dimensions specific to the EventHub, setting up key-value pairs for Path and ObjectPoolId.
